events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and its impact on global geopolitics is being felt. The US has shown military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is a concern. The situation in the Middle East is volatile, with Israel facing strategic problems.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will lead to increased volatility in the oil market, affecting oil services stocks. However, the tech sector, particularly those involved in AI and cybersecurity, may see a boost due to increased demand for their services.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation in the Middle East and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the situation in the Middle East stabilizes or when oil prices drop significantly

gains.conservativeNote: If the situation in the Middle East stabilizes quickly

events.title: US Inflation Rate
events.summary: The US inflation rate has cooled, and traders expect the Fed to skip the July rate hike. The PPI data has lowered market odds of interest rate increases this year.
events.reasoning: The cooled inflation rate and expected skip of the July rate hike will lead to increased investor confidence, boosting the stock market. Rotating to shorter-term credit bonds may provide a safe haven for investors.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed decisions

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the Fed decides to raise interest rates or when inflation picks up

gains.extendedNote: If the Fed cuts interest rates

otherFactors: Geopolitical instability in the Middle East
